title: airella cupaniana
intro: Airella cupaniana, commonly known as sea sandwort, is a type of flowering plant in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). The health benefits of Airella cupaniana include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its rich antioxidant and flavonoid content. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can be used to treat various conditions such as wounds, skin irritations, and respiratory issues. Airella cupaniana contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
